description: Implement a robust file upload system for support tickets that properly handles multiple file drops, tracks individual file upload progress, and enforces file limits. The system should provide clear visual feedback for each file's upload status and maintain a clean, consistent UI across chat interfaces.
functional_requirements: Implement file drop functionality that appends new files to existing selections rather than replacing them
Track and display individual upload progress for each file with explicit success/error status indicators
Enforce a maximum file limit (MAX_FILES) and prevent users from exceeding it
Update chat bubble and embedded chat UI components to use subtler borders and cleaner shadows for consistency
Ensure the upload system properly isolates the chat area from other UI elements
